title: Display
description: Display behaviour that is not part of a layout: day and night brightness, the status strip on swipe and the layout push port. The namespace is "cockpit" because the espOS HMI Designer writes cockpit.brightness, as it does on espos-p4-cockpit.

keys.name: night_bright
keys.title: Night brightness
keys.description: Backlight while Signal K reports environment.mode night (signalk-espos-manager publishes it from the sun at the boat's position). 0 keeps the day brightness at night. Below 5 % is the same as 5 %, the dimmest step the backlight has.

keys.name: status_peek_s
keys.title: Status strip on swipe
keys.description: For a layout that hides the status strip: a swipe down from the top edge shows it above the widgets for this long. Any touch while it shows starts the time again; a tap on it closes it. While Signal K is unreachable it stays up.

keys.name: api_port
keys.title: Layout API port
keys.description: TCP port of the JSON Layout Player API the designer talks to (/layout, /hello, /screenshot).
